business_summary: Poly Developments and Holdings Group Co., Ltd. engages in the investment, development, and management of real estate properties in China and internationally. It is also involved new home sales agency, digital marketing, existing home brokerage, and channel distribution; architectural design; operation of convention and exhibitions; private equity fund management; investment in healthcare; and silk business. In addition . the company operates and manages shopping malls, hotels, tourist spots, and diversified urban services, as well as golf courses, theme parks, natural ecological landscape resorts, cultural tourism destinations, and tourism real estate properties. Further, it provides property services, as well as long-term and short-term rental apartments. Poly Developments and Holdings Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Poly Developments and Holdings Group Co., Ltd.는 중국 및 해외 부동산 투자, 개발 및 관리에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 신규 주택 판매 대행사, 디지털 마케팅, 기존 주택 중개 및 채널 유통도 포함됩니다. 건축 디자인; 컨벤션 및 전시회 운영; 사모펀드 관리; 의료 투자; 그리고 실크 사업. 게다가 . 쇼핑몰, 호텔, 관광지, 다양한 도시서비스, 골프장, 테마파크, 자연생태경관리조트, 문화관광지, 관광부동산 등을 운영, 관리하는 회사입니다. 또한 부동산 서비스는 물론 장기 및 단기 임대 아파트도 제공합니다. Poly Developments and Holdings Group Co., Ltd.는 1992년에 설립되었으며 중국 광저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
